description: This file contains the PHP class `Article` within the namespace `Opencart.Admin.Model.Cms`. It provides various methods for managing articles in the OpenCart e-commerce platform's administrative API, including creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving article data, descriptions, SEO URLs, store associations, and layouts.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Represents the Article model within the admin CMS namespace, providing CRUD operations and related data management for articles in the OpenCart backend.

methods.name: addArticle
methods.description: Creates a new article with associated descriptions, store relations, SEO URLs, layouts, and invalidates cache.

methods.name: editArticle
methods.description: Updates an existing article’s details and related data, including descriptions, store relations, SEO URLs, layouts, and cache.

methods.name: deleteArticle
methods.description: Deletes an article and all its related descriptions, store links, SEO URLs, layouts, comments, and clears cache.

methods.name: getArticle
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific article, including description data for the current language.

methods.name: getArticles
methods.description: Fetches a list of articles based on filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getTotalArticles
methods.description: Returns the total number of articles matching certain filter criteria.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for an article in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a given article ID.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for articles in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions associated with a specific article.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for articles in a specific language.

methods.name: editRating
methods.description: Updates the rating value for a specific article.
